subject: space
title: My first space mission
summary: Meet the Sun, Earth and Moon, discover rocky planets and explore tools used in space.

items.label: Sun
items.fact: The Sun is a star that gives Earth light and warmth.
items.clue: Which star gives Earth light and warmth?

items.label: Earth
items.fact: Earth is the planet where we live.

items.label: Moon
items.fact: Our Moon travels around Earth. It reflects light from the Sun.
items.clue: Which object travels around Earth and reflects sunlight?

items.label: Mercury
items.fact: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.
items.clue: Find the rocky planet closest to the Sun.

items.label: Venus
items.fact: Venus is the second planet from the Sun. Thick clouds cover it.
items.clue: Find the second planet from the Sun, which is covered in thick clouds.

items.label: Mars
items.fact: Mars looks reddish because much of its surface contains rusty dust.
items.clue: Find the planet that looks red because of rusty dust.

items.label: rocket
items.fact: A rocket can carry instruments and people into space.
items.clue: Which tool can launch people or equipment into space?

items.label: telescope
items.fact: A telescope helps us see objects that are very far away.
items.clue: Which instrument helps us look at distant stars?

items.label: artificial satellite
items.fact: People make satellites that travel around Earth to do jobs like taking weather pictures.
items.clue: Which machine can travel around Earth and take pictures of the weather?
